Aaj ki resipi chaval ke aate ki bahut hi kurkuri aur khasta papri/mathri. ise aap aasani se banakar mahine bhar ke lie stor kar sakte hain . sham ki chay, achar ya chatni ke sath ise parosiye sabhi ko pasand aayegi
Today we are making super crispy and crunchy Rice Flour Papdi / Mathri. This easy tea-time snack has a long shelf life and can be stored for over a month. Serve it with evening tea, chutney, or pickle!
